Is my dad's elder brother’s wife that is my aunty a mahram or non mahram for me? 5895 views Q. a-o-a I had a dream about my uncle around a year later after his death were I see my self praying in the front row of a Friday prayer with all levels of people gathered. Then when I turn around, I see my uncle talking and laughing at his son explaining that in life he should take responsibility and that my uncle is safe and health. From physical description I see him in white cloths, well built in muscle, happy looking, with a black sheet covering his left side and stuff like kajal, topi, small beard, white skin even if he was a bit brown before death. I feel like everything isn?t right, as if I have been shown this dream to take care of his family. The first thought I had when I awake from the dream was marrying his daughter who I haven?t seen yet. What should be done, and what from your knowledge this dream really means? I was told by my parents that they are converting to chiasm and they are so young, I am in my 20ties and am not strong enough to be trusted by them. I feel really worried. By Muhammed Faizan Mustafa My second question is that I see him again in a second dream a few months later were he is looking at me in a cloudy crowd, but I am not so confident about it because it was short and more of a vision then a dream. What does this mean and what does he want me to do. Why do I see this dream when I have never lived with him by. 1543 views Q. فروری 2015 کو جمعہ کی رات میں میرے والد کا انتقال ہوگیا۔ 1409 views Q. I would like to know about a dream that I had once. It was when I was about 12 years old and it should have been after sunrise sometime. I saw myself in the night in the hospital giving birth to a son, then I remember loving the son greatly and keeping him with me. After this, I gave him to my father to look after and when I came back looking for him, he was lost and I just saw flashes of him here and there; then I started crying in the dream and woke up. I felt very strange after waking up and became attached to the idea of motherhood. I think I need the meaning of this dream, jazak Allahu khair. 1357 views Q. Question: I saw a dream My Sheikh Who is well known Dayee working hard to Introduce Islam among non Muslims at new delhi railway station.I met him conveyed salam to him.He told you bring a taxi for markaz Nizamuddin.I tried my best but unable to get taxi.In the meanwhile I met my one of the friend.He asked what is the matter. I told that Maulana who isIs daur ka sabse Allah ka chaheta banda station per hai chalo tum bhi milo.we went back to see hazrat maulana but we found him giving dawa to coolies on outside of railway station. We turned back to hire taxi for markaz but in vain.Previously I was working with jamate tablighue actively but nowadays I am working among nonmuslims only due to persional disputes with my local tablighy sathies. Please convey the tabeer of khwab to me please? Answer ID: 23117 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1305/989/H=1431) It means that you are the victim of aggression and oppression in this dispute. Your attention is drawn to reform it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
